product.name: Harnessie
product.description: A brain-agnostic multi-agent harness whose Golden Rule, read together and write only what you own, is enforced through consent, per-agent file ownership, workspace confinement, independent verification, human-only arbitration, and tamper-evident audit records.

release_context.note: Evidence bundles, structured claim verdicts, OpenAI Responses, Ringer regression fixtures, and trace metrics ship in core 1.2.0. Verify Action v0.2.0, stable v0, and the Homebrew 1.2.0 formula are verified downstreams; main also contains post-release publishing-recovery maintenance recorded in CHANGELOG.md.

capabilities.name: Review a Harnessie checkout
capabilities.description: A bounded GuideCheck guide for inspecting a checkout and reporting evidence before a human authorizes any action.
capabilities.side_effects: The guide authorizes read-only inspection only. Installation, code execution, and mutation require a separate human-approved task.

integrity_status.served_copy: 1.2.0 repository and served guide copies are byte-identical and pinned by the provenance sidecar
integrity_status.external_anchor: The 1.2.0 DNS TXT and hosted-verifier re-anchor is pending; the 1.1.0 matching-anchor receipt remains historical evidence only
integrity_status.current_end_to_end_level: Pending external re-verification for the 1.2.0 guide

capabilities.name: Verify claims about a local artifact
capabilities.description: Runs deterministic checks before an independent fresh-context verifier and exits fail-closed when a verdict cannot be earned.
capabilities.stable_1_2_contract: Raw criteria or a v1 evidence bundle, deterministic checks, an optional independent verifier, structured required-claim coverage, and fail-closed exit codes 0, 1, and 2.

capabilities.name: Validate Harnessie authoring contracts
capabilities.description: Validates stable v1 configuration and workflow schemas plus cross-document references without starting a run.

capabilities.name: Explain one ownership decision
capabilities.description: Evaluates the exact ownership-ledger decision for one workspace path and agent without claiming or modifying the path.

capabilities.name: Run a governed local workflow
capabilities.description: Runs consented task packets under Harnessie's Golden Rule for agent work: read together, write only what you own. Ownership lanes, OS-sandboxed shell work, verification gates, audited stop conditions, and explicitly selected operator-trusted tool plugins enforce the shipped boundary.
capabilities.plugin_boundary: Installed harnessie.tools.v1 plugins never auto-load. Each --plugin selection imports operator-trusted in-process code; registry mediation is not a sandbox.

boundaries.note: Harnessie is installed and run locally. These declarations describe the released 1.2.0 core and do not advertise a hosted agent, API, or MCP server.
